title: Sunset Sails

services.name: Whale & Dolphin Watching Tours
services.desc: Pacific Marine Charters offers an intimate and unique view of the local wildlife and some BIG visitors. 20,000 grey whales migrate pass Oceanside and witnessing their passing is a sight to behold. Whales, Dolphins, Sea Lions… These are just the start of what is coming your way. Keep those cameras ready for some of the best memories you’ll ever capture. Our experienced Captains know where to look and how to get you the best views without disturbing any of the animals you will see. With 70 miles of coastline directly in the migration path, North Count San Diego has the best view for seeing these gentle giants. services.name: Sail Oceanside
services.desc: Hello, my name is Bill DeLuna and I am the owner of Pacific Marine Charters and one of 3 captains that currently operate our fleet of boats. I owned my first boat when I was a mere 14 years old. I still remember when my father would tow my little aluminum fishing boat down to Los Alamitos Harbor in Long Beach and drop me off to go fishing for the day. He would then pick me up at the end of his work day, load up the boat, and drive us home. There has never been a time since then that I wasn’t fishing, boating or sailing along the Southern California coastline or in the lakes that dot our urban landscape. Fast forward 38 years!
